skills.name: Bone Assault (骸袭)
skills.line: Anyone who steps back will be cut down!
skills.description: Gashadokuro attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Soulful Kiss (花吻烈魂)
skills.description: Exclusive effect. At the start of battle, Gashadokuro grant the ally with the highest ATK a Blood Red Flower. When he loses HP, he will not be KO'd and the lost HP will be stored in a Taira Shield. ;Upon Usage :Gashadokuro transfers a Blood Red Flower to a non-summoned ally. ;Blood Red Flower (血色之花) : :'''Common, Mark''': When an ally other than himself with this effect receives damage, Gashadokuro will share 40% of the damage as lost HP and the ally will be immune to the first lethal damage they receive. ;Taira Shield (平氏之盾) :Can absorb damage equal to the stored lost HP, up to a max of 50% of Gashadokuro's initial HP.

upgrades.text: '''Blood Red Flower''': Shared damaged increases to 45%.
While the ally with Blood Red Flower is immune to lethal damage, they also gain a Taira Shield equal to the total lost HP of Gashadokuro.
'''Blood Red Flower''': Shared damaged increases to 50%.
When the turn of the ally with Blood Red Flower ends, Gashadokuro immediately enters the Rift in Time (can only trigger once before the start of each turn).

skills.name: Underworld Banner (黄泉战旗)
skills.line: My bones are a thousand times harder than this shield!
skills.description: Gashadokuro launches attacks an enemy twice, losing 30% of his max HP to deal true damage equal to 8% and 20% of his lost HP with each attack respectively (cannot exceed 1200% of his initial ATK).

upgrades.text: True damage of the 2nd attack increases to 25%.
When using this skill while in the Rift in Time, onibi cost is decreased by 2.
True damage of the 2nd attack increases to 30%.
When he KO's an enemy shikigami, his max HP is increased by 35% of his initial amount and an equal amount of HP is recovered.

bio.condition: With Gashadokuro clear any zone 30 times.
